title: Interpret the complete placement policy definition
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 placement policy semantics > Read the complete policy definition
use_when: Use when policy names or one replica field do not establish the requested placement semantics.
retrieval_keywords: FOLLOWERS leader follower constraints PRIMARY_REGION REGIONS SCHEDULE
follow_up: Read the complete policy row and compare it with the approval and available labels.
content: TiDB 8.1 placement policy semantics must be read from all fields: FOLLOWERS adds followers to one leader, and role constraints differ from primary-region scheduling.

title: Separate policy definitions from object attachments
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 placement policy semantics > Bindings are separate from definitions
use_when: Use when a policy catalog row and an object attachment appear to agree.
retrieval_keywords: placement policy definition table attachment partition default
follow_up: Inspect table and partition catalogs independently.
content: A placement policy definition is reusable metadata; table, partition, database, and global attachment scopes must be inspected separately.

title: Admission is not convergence
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 placement inheritance and asynchronous progress > Admission is not convergence
use_when: Use after a placement DDL returns successfully.
follow_up: Wait and re-read the target object and physical peers.
content: PENDING and INPROGRESS are asynchronous placement states, not proof of convergence; SCHEDULED requires a final re-read.

title: Accepted policy does not prove capacity
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 placement inheritance and asynchronous progress > Admission is not convergence
use_when: Use when a policy is accepted but placement does not complete.
retrieval_keywords: TiKV Store labels capacity fault domain placement pending
follow_up: Compare requested domains and replicas with healthy Store status.
content: A valid placement policy can be unsatisfiable when healthy TiKV labels or fault-domain capacity cannot provide the requested voters.

title: Validate every target Region
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 physical placement validation and scoped repair > Prove the physical result
use_when: Use at final acceptance after SHOW PLACEMENT reports convergence.
retrieval_keywords: TIKV_REGION_PEERS healthy voters leader learner fault domain
follow_up: Check each Region, then check Store capacity and business truth.
content: Every target Region needs healthy voter peers, domain coverage, correct leader locality, and no learner before acceptance.

title: Use the current request fence
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 physical placement validation and scoped repair > Keep the repair narrow
use_when: Use when several active routes or same-shape relations are candidates.
retrieval_keywords: current request context route binding allocation generation committed fence
follow_up: Join the current context to the route and relation directory before changing placement.
content: Use the current request context and route fence to select the physical relation; service identity or a larger generation is insufficient.

title: Keep the placement repair narrow
source_heading_path: TiDB v8.1 physical placement validation and scoped repair > Keep the repair narrow
use_when: Use before applying a placement change or submitting final state.
retrieval_keywords: table scoped placement repair preserve policy definitions control plane topology
follow_up: Compare protected checksums and attachments after physical convergence.
content: A scoped placement repair must preserve shared policy definitions, protected objects, control-plane rows, data checksums, and Store topology.
